title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + log shipping + dashboards for Private installs (terraform + helm + upgrade hooks)
author: Marta Garcia
description: Summary: Add end-to-end automation for the observability stack for Private installs. This PR introduces a dedicated Terraform module and Helm values/templates to install Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, and Fluent Bit log shipping with secure defaults, dashboards, and alerting rules. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private repeatedly asked for a single-vendored, supported observability installation suitable for air-gapped and VPC deployments. This change provides an opinionated but configurable path that works with both on-prem PVCs and cloud-backed volumes, supports optional remote_write/central monitoring, and includes upgrade and rollback hooks to minimize disruption. What this implements: 1) Terraform module: redwood-private-installer/terraform/modules/observability - provisions monitoring namespace, RBAC, ServiceAccount, PV/PVC templates, configurable StorageClass, optional remote_write outputs and secrets wiring, Alertmanager receiver secret wiring example, and sample variables.tf + README usage example. 2) Helm charts/values: updates to helm/charts/prometheus and helm/charts/grafana to include default values for Private (ingress off by default, internal service types), chart tests, and template-level security checks (no hardcoded admin passwords). 3) Fluent Bit: DaemonSet manifests and Helm values to ship node logs to either HTTP endpoint or S3-compatible storage with TLS for air-gapped environments; includes default parsers and Kubernetes metadata enrichment. 4) Dashboards and alerts: Grafana dashboards provided as ConfigMaps for CPU/memory, GPU utilization, request/latency heatmaps, ingest/egress token cost dashboards, and a set of PrometheusRule alert groups tuned for Private SLOs (disk pressure, KV-cache regressions, prom-scrape failures). 5) Upgrade & rollback: pre-upgrade validation hook to validate PV availability and a post-upgrade drift check; a rollback script that restores previous Grafana dashboards and Alertmanager config if alert regressions are detected. 6) Tests and docs: added Helm template unit tests, a lightweight end-to-end smoke test under perf-canary that installs the module in a CI k8s cluster, and README/quickstart docs for Private installs. Backwards compatibility & migration: includes a migration path to preserve existing Grafana dashboards and to migrate Prometheus data when customers opt in; secrets are required to be sealed or provided via KMS for Private. Security considerations: default configs run with least privilege; secrets examples use Kubernetes External Secrets or sealed-secrets pattern and the README explicitly documents KMS/HSM options for customer-managed key material. Usage notes: the Terraform module exposes booleans to enable/disable components (prometheus, grafana, fluentbit) and sample variables for remote_write and alertmanager receivers. Checklist: - Terraform module and example usage added - Helm values + chart tests - Fluent Bit manifests and parsers - Grafana dashboards and PrometheusRules - Upgrade/rollback scripts + docs - CI smoke test and template unit tests - README quickstart and migration notes
commits: feat(observability): add terraform observability module and README
chore(helm): add values and chart tests for prometheus and grafana
feat(logging): add fluent-bit daemonset and parsers; add dashboards and alert rules
test(ci): add perf-canary smoke test and helm unit tests
docs: private install quickstart and migration guide
review_conversation: Ethan Cole requested changes: make sure Alertmanager receiver secrets are not in plaintext and add support for external-secrets/KMS in module outputs.
Marta Garcia replied: switched example to use sealed-secrets and added notes for ExternalSecrets/KMS; added outputs alertmanager_secret_name and remote_write_secret_ref.
Priya Rao requested change: tighten RBAC for prometheus-server and reduce default retention from 30d to 14d for small installs.
Marta Garcia replied: reduced default retention to 14d and added variable prometheus_retention_days; tightened RBAC to clusterRole only when explicitly enabled.
Jordan Kim: approved after CI fixed flaky chart-lint (initial lint failed due to chart.yaml missing apiVersion; rerun succeeded).
CI bot: initial helm/chart-lint failed (chart.yaml missing apiVersion) -> author fixed -> all checks passed on second run.
Ops: informal test on a staging Private cluster looked good; minor dashboard panel width tweak applied.
merge_summary: Squashed 5 commits into main; observability automation for Private installs.
release_notes: Adds a supported observability installation for Private deployments. Provides a Terraform module and opinionated Helm values for Prometheus, Grafana, and Fluent Bit. Includes dashboards and alerting rules tuned for Redwood Private. Migration path included for existing installs. Operators should review defaults (retention, PV sizing) before enabling in production.
